verdicts.title: Schur multipliers of special p-groups of rank 2
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A group G is called special p-group of rank k if the commutator subgroup [G,G] and centre Z(G) are equal, which is elementary abelian p-group of rank k and G/[G,G] is also elementary abelian p-group. In this article we determine the Schur multiplier of special p-groups of rank 2 explicitly.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns Schur multipliers of special p-groups of rank 2, a pure group theory result with no connection to sandpile groups, circuit complexity, or PARITY approximation. Shared use of 'p-group' vocabulary does not interact with the specific claim.

verdicts.title: On Automorphisms of Finite $p$-groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $G$ be a finite $p$-group such that $x\Z(G) \subseteq x^G$ for all $x \in G- \Z(G)$, where $x^G$ denotes the conjugacy class of $x$ in $G$. Then $|G|$ divides $|\Aut(G)|$, where $\Aut(G)$ is the group of all automorphisms of $G$.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns automorphism groups of finite p-groups with a conjugacy-class containment condition ('x Z(G) ⊆ x^G'), which is unrelated to sandpile groups, Laplacian 2-ranks, or ACC^0 circuit lower bounds for PARITY.
